name: gtm-role-descriptions
description: GTM job descriptions, org structure, and compensation — role-by-role JD templates, revenue org charts by ARR stage, OTE/quota/comp plans, and posting channels. Includes GTM Engineer hiring (vs RevOps, SE, Growth Engineer). Grounded in Betts Recruiting, Bridge Group, RepVue, Pavilion, and Winning by Design POD design. Use when writing a job description, designing revenue org structure, setting sales comp, or hiring SDR/AE/RevOps/GTM Engineer/CS/Marketing roles. Triggers on: "job description", "JD for", "write a job post", "sales comp plan", "OTE quota", "revenue org chart", "hire SDR", "hire AE", "VP Sales job description", "RevOps role", "GTM Engineer", "hire GTM engineer", "org structure GTM".
